title: Hearty Saudi Arabian Butter Beans Kebabs
description: A traditional Saudi Arabian dish featuring butter beans, this recipe is perfect for a solo dinner and is diabetic-friendly, with a char-grill flavor and a grassy, chewy texture.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, garlic, ginger, cumin, coriander, paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Add the butter beans to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the marinated butter beans onto skewers, leaving a small space between each bean.
Grill the kebabs for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally, until they are charred and tender.
Brush the kebabs with lemon juice during the last 2 minutes of grilling.
Serve the kebabs hot, garnished with fresh parsley or cilantro.
Let the kebabs rest for a few minutes before serving.
Serve with a side of Saudi Arabian flatbread or rice.
